text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I thought I heard someone call for me, 
but... is no one here?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... and here I was looking forward to 
something exciting happening...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ah, a statue of the Three Goddesses.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Those whose names are called receive woven 
feelings... ...Maybe it's okay to believe 
in a jinx like that?
